questions.why: Frieza belongs to the Frost Demon race, which also includes his father and his brother Cooler.
King Cold is Frieza's father; Cooler is a brother.

questions.q: After Frieza kills Krillin on Namek, which hero first turns Super Saiyan?
questions.why: The loss of Krillin triggers Goku's famous golden transformation.

questions.q: Frieza wiped out which Saiyan homeworld?
questions.why: He blew up Planet Vegeta long before later destroying Namek.

questions.q: Who is credited with slicing the mechanical Frieza to pieces?
questions.why: Trunks sliced the mechanical Frieza into pieces.

questions.q: In Funimation's in-house English dub of Dragon Ball Z, who voiced Frieza?
questions.why: Linda Young played him through the Z series; Christopher Ayres took over later in Kai and onward.

questions.q: Toriyama named Frieza's elite fighters after which kind of items?
questions.why: The Ginyu Force and other minions have names from fruits and dairy, a refrigerator joke tied to the boss's name.

questions.q: In which Dragon Ball manga chapter does Frieza make his debut?
questions.why: Dark Clouds Swirl Over Planet Namek, chapter 247 in late 1989, first brought him in.

questions.q: Frieza's Golden form in Resurrection 'F' follows how long of training?
questions.why: After being revived, he trained for four months to reach the golden form.

questions.q: Toriyama said Frieza was modelled on which group of people?
options: Yakuza bosses of the postwar black market
Feudal warlords of the Sengoku period
questions.why: Toriyama pointed to bubble-era land speculators, a kind of people he disliked, as the model for the polite tyrant.
